Applying to the STEP school
There are 3 stages to the application process:
1- Application to the ED
Complete the single application form in conjunction with your thesis supervisors and send it to the head of the department.
2- Pedagogical registration, once your application has been validated by the ED
Interview with the ED Director of the candidate and his/her supervisors
Signing of the Thesis Charter and the Training Agreement by the candidate, the supervisory team, the lab director and the ED Director
3- Administrative registration in conjunction with the Doctoral College's Registrar's Office
Recruitment is based on 4 elements
1. Have a master's degree or equivalent
2. Have a research laboratory
3. Have a thesis supervisor
See all subjects
4. Funding (minimum 36 months at minimum wage)
Foreign degrees will be subject to a request for equivalence (files examined by the ED).
